title: Core Galois action formula on geometric etale lifts
statement: Under the field and separable-closure hypotheses of the geometric point over Spec K, there exists a monoid homomorphism from Gal(Ks/K) to endomorphisms of the geometric etale fibre functor satisfying the precomposition formula for every extending automorphism of Omega. No openness is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the already proved lem-exc-etale-lift-sepclosed-base to each Omega-valued lift along an etale X -> Spec K, with L = Ks and tau = Spec(K -> Ks). The scalar tower identity identifies Spec(Ks -> Omega) followed by tau with Spec(K -> Omega). The lemma gives a Ks-valued lift and both required equalities. This proves surjectivity of precomposition on fibres.

The proved Scheme.SpecMap_comp_injective shows that precomposition with the field embedding Ks -> Omega is injective on scheme morphisms; extensionality of Over morphisms gives injectivity on fibre elements. Naturality is associativity, and these componentwise bijections assemble to a natural isomorphism e.

Define the Ks action directly: g acts on a lift y by Spec(g) followed by y. Its over-K condition is g.toAlgHom.comp_algebraMap; naturality is associativity. Spec.map_comp and reflexivity prove the unit and multiplication laws. Transport this monoid homomorphism through e by rho(g) = e.inv followed by a(g) followed by e.hom. The inverse identities of e prove the transported monoid laws.

For an Omega lift x put y = e.inv_X(x). The inverse identity gives Spec(Ks -> Omega) followed by y = x. The assumed equality (Ks -> Omega) composed with g = tau composed with (Ks -> Omega), mapped contravariantly through Spec and followed by y, gives the required extension formula. This argument uses no existence or choice of extending automorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03QW, paragraph before Theorem 59.56.3; S1 implements descent and action transport using the proved Scheme.Hom.exists_SpecMap_comp_eq_of_isSepClosed and Scheme.SpecMap_comp_injective, rather than extending automorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_galoisPointAction_core
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] :
    let S := Spec (.of K)
    let s := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω))
    let p := pointSmallEtale s
    ∃ ρ : Gal(Ks/K) →* End p.fiber,
      ∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
          (_ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
            τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
          (X : S.Etale) (x : p.fiber.obj X),
        ((ρ g).app X x).left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left
